purpose: Build bounded implementation plans with dependencies and testable acceptance.

trigger: Create an implementation plan with files, owners and tests
Break this feature into ordered development tasks
Prepare a task plan in a local project document
do_not_trigger: Execute the plan and deploy it immediately
Read weather forecasts for next week
Approve a GitHub merge without review

preflight: Confirm requirements, current code revision and non-goals.
List allowed output file and identify whether creating a plan is authorized.
workflow: Decompose into dependency-ordered tasks with unique file ownership.
Associate each task with acceptance evidence, rollback and budget.
Cross-check coverage of constraints, conflicting dependencies and unresolved decisions.
Write only authorized plan file and verify its content hash.

evidence.how_to_verify: Review full task graph, scope and acceptance checks for contradictions.
Confirm output path and content hash from filesystem read-back.

failure_modes: Do not mark implementation complete from an approved plan alone.
If tasks form a cycle or ownership conflict, block execution and revise plan.
